raw:
Seraphel draws out the chair across from you and lays the slim book beside your borrowed history volume. Its cover shows a rain-dark road disappearing beneath a crooked little bridge.

“*The Pilgrim’s Wet Road,* by Verrin Bell.  
He hates rain, and records it well.

“He also distrusts ferrymen and tea.  
I like the part where nothing happens at sea.

“Would you hear the worst passage read aloud?  
It is much worse when given voice, I’ve found.”
